description:
Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add: new lib/zaq/agent/tools/data_source/attach_documents.ex; lib/zaq/agent/tools/registry.ex; new test/zaq/agent/tools/data_source/attach_documents_test.exs and selection property tests; registry tests. Use workflow Action schema/hooks conventions for the Action contract, but workflow/notification wiring stays PR7. Action name attach_documents; preserve reference Registry key data_source.attach_document unless live discovery proves an existing collision. Explicit tool enablement remains required. Input operation add/remove/replace and complete provenance-bearing file Records (reference bounded list schema); output a validated operation/Record instruction only. Tool success means selection, never upload/delivery.
Reuse GetDocument through the established validated composed ActionContract/Jido.Exec boundary to refresh data-source records from signed provider/config/provider_record_id, preserving required scope such as selected disk volume through existing APIs. For other signed Records use Authorization.can?(context.actor, record, :read). An active pending native request and trusted actor are mandatory; explicit literal top-level skip_permissions may opt in to permission bypass but never invalid kind/provenance. Validate the full invocation before applying it: invalid/denied mixed inputs reject atomically, leaving the request's earlier selection untouched. Do not accept model actor fields or flat identity aliases. No destination lookup/validate_files event, size filtering, content download, outbound send, persistent selection store or transport errors.
Pure reducer owns stable verified source identity/order: add keeps first occurrence, remove deselects without source deletion, replace sets exact deduplicated list, replace [] clears. Signed projection refresh does not duplicate a source, but provider/config boundaries never collapse distinct documents. Reject unusable identities rather than deduplicating everything under nil.
Tests to add before implementation: Jido validated schema input/output and registry resolution/enablement; current metadata refresh with real internal boundaries; stale/revoked/forged/missing provenance, wrong kind, actor spoof, nil actor, nonliteral bypass, explicit bypass authenticity, missing/inactive native request and empty clear. Assert zero materialization/send/destination validation calls and large/unknown-size Records remain selectable. Pure generated operation sequences prove deterministic ordered dedup/removal/exact replace and scope separation.
Branches/paths validated: successful metadata refresh, generic authorization, denied batch preserving prior selection, absent connector/destination, remove absent file, duplicates/fresh signatures, malformed records and no implicit permission grants.
Mocking plan: pure reducer needs none; real ACL/Record/NodeRouter boundaries and disk fixtures; fake only external provider HTTP. Use existing validated execution, never direct run/2 in consumer tests.
Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content: Action @moduledoc/schema descriptions and docs/services/agent.md tool contract. Remove reference prose claiming a failed selection poisons future sends; explain selection versus delivery and retry feedback.
Action reuse assessment: new Action because GetDocument only reads metadata and DownloadDocument redeems content; neither selects a request's final files. Own selection-only contract here; reuse metadata/ACL/provenance operations rather than copying them. Pure reducer is local-only domain logic, not another exposed Action. Agent registry exposure is deliberate; programmatic callers use validation, while standalone/workflow invocation without an active request returns an error. Retry is safe as an instruction; reducer dedup and invocation replay handling make state application idempotent. Tests prove internal operations are reused and no delivery occurs.

Implementation constraints: This is a proposed plan only. The current request authorizes setup and Beadwork planning, not implementation, commits, pushes, rebases or publication. Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/documentation.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md before later execution; read the owning service guide and each touched module's @moduledoc. Agent work also follows docs/services/agent.md#harness-critical-checks-for-coding-agents. Recheck live source/contracts after PR5 advances. Preserve existing test behavior; if an assertion/scenario must change, record old/proposed behavior and obtain specific human approval first. No such changes are approved here. New unit/integration/property tests are immediate and written before production code. Keep real internal boundaries and isolated fixture/process state; inject runtime dependencies through established opts/context and Zaq.Config.get/4 where relevant, without global configuration mutation. Follow the authoritative validation lifecycle in docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md; do not treat historical/reference runs as current validation. PR5 owns delivery execution/outcomes; PR7 owns RunAgent, NotifyPerson and notification/workflow integration.
